commit_message:
[turbofan] Propagate safe int check via truncation

ConvertTaggedHoleToUndefined bypass the use_info check when the
input is a number and we are truncating to word32.

Here, we propagate that we shouldn't do that if we speculate
that the input is in the safe integer range.

Fixed: 414738826
Change-Id: Iafed74f00ce6af19e599cf2264b79c6d7179beac

Reviewed-by: Nico Hartmann <nicohartmann@chromium.org>

findings.title: CheckedSafeIntAsWord64 missing check_safe_integer flag in Truncation
findings.message: The introducing commit `22f006269` added a `check_safe_integer_` field to the `Truncation` class and updated `IsLessGeneralThan()` to enforce `(check_safe_integer() <= other.check_safe_integer())` as part of the monotonicity check in Turbofan's simplified lowering pass. It correctly marked `CheckedSafeIntTruncatingWord32` with `Truncation::Word32WithSafeIntCheck()` (check_safe_integer=true), but left `CheckedSafeIntAsWord64` using the plain `Truncation::Any()` (check_safe_integer=false). When a JIT-compiled node is first visited with a use_info whose truncation carries check_safe_integer=true (e.g., via Generalize of a Word32WithSafeIntCheck truncation), and then revisited with `CheckedSafeIntAsWord64`'s `Truncation::Any()` (check_safe_integer=false), the monotonicity DCHECK `IsLessGeneralThan(true, false)` evaluates to false and fires: `DCHECK(IsUseLessGeneral(input_use_infos_[index], use_info))` in simplified-lowering.cc.
findings.suggestion: Use `Truncation::Any(kDistinguishZeros, true)` instead of `Truncation::Any()` in `CheckedSafeIntAsWord64` to set `check_safe_integer = true`, consistent with `CheckedSafeIntTruncatingWord32` using `Truncation::Word32WithSafeIntCheck()`. This ensures the monotonicity invariant holds when both UseInfo types are mixed during Turbofan's iterative re-processing of nodes.

ground_truth.root_cause: The `check_safe_integer_` field was added to `Truncation` and used in `IsLessGeneralThan()` to require that `check_safe_integer` values only increase (false→true) across successive visits. `CheckedSafeIntTruncatingWord32` was updated to emit a truncation with `check_safe_integer=true`, but `CheckedSafeIntAsWord64` was missed and still emits `Truncation::Any()` with `check_safe_integer=false`. When nodes are visited with a mix of these two use infos, the monotonicity check `(true <= false)` fails.
